assumptions_worth_preserving.assumption: Clean-room authorship and no proprietary assets/source in tracked outputs.
assumptions_worth_preserving.reason: This is a legal/ethical project invariant and is repeated in AGENTS.md, tools/spore/README.md, and docs/STATE.md.

assumptions_worth_preserving.assumption: Decompiler output is evidence, not truth; no MSVC RTTI means type casts and FUN_* names are not trusted semantics.
assumptions_worth_preserving.reason: Required to prevent OpenSpore implementation guesses from being promoted as original behavior.

assumptions_worth_preserving.assumption: The canonical evidence scale is UNKNOWN < APPROXIMATION < INFERRED < SUPPORTED < OBSERVED < CONFIRMED < VERIFIED, with evidence_level in the KG and replacement-status as a separate status vocabulary.
assumptions_worth_preserving.reason: Prevents the stale overlapping confidence/status systems from reappearing.

assumptions_worth_preserving.assumption: The original game is an external oracle under Wine; OpenSpore fixtures prove determinism and contract stability, not fidelity to the original.
assumptions_worth_preserving.reason: The replacement boundary and status rules explicitly distinguish a decompilation reference from a live runtime oracle.

assumptions_worth_preserving.assumption: Negative observations are evidence: zero cell-stage probe events and blocked/stalled Wine runs must be recorded, not hidden or retried indefinitely.
assumptions_worth_preserving.reason: The observatory and orchestration designs make failed traces first-class artifacts and cap attempts.

assumptions_worth_preserving.assumption: Read-only/loopback boundaries matter: viewer cannot write, MCP asset tools return metadata only, SPORE is never written, and shared display/GPU work uses a machine lock.
assumptions_worth_preserving.reason: These are current safety invariants with test coverage and explicit security boundaries.

assumptions_worth_preserving.assumption: Determinism is a first-class contract: fixed 1/60 simulation, no time/rand, frozen JSON fixtures, double-run byte identity, and same-host/toolchain scope.
assumptions_worth_preserving.reason: The simulation contract and tests make this explicit, including the cross-platform limitation.

assumptions_worth_preserving.assumption: A narrow parser that rejects unsupported versions/structures is safer than silently accepting unknown data.
assumptions_worth_preserving.reason: GMDL, RW4, texture, and CellResource code use explicit errors and record accounting; this makes future support extension visible.

definitions.INFERRED: Reasoned architecture conclusion or original semantic claim from one source, not directly reproduced by a live original runtime trace.
definitions.OBSERVED: Directly present in current source, tests, generated artifact, or a committed binary/byte observation; this does not automatically prove original semantics.
definitions.SUPPORTED: Multiple consistent sources or a deterministic differential/contract check; still not a claim of broader original fidelity when the original oracle is absent.

evidence_policy.original_semantics_rule: OpenSpore source alone cannot establish original gameplay. Original semantic claims require a linked SDK/Ghidra/byte/runtime artifact, and promotion above replaced-approx requires live evidence under the documented replacement gates.
evidence_policy.scope_rule: SPORE, decompiler casts, FUN_* names, and runtime outputs are evidence inputs only. They are not copied source and do not expand the implementation scope.

implementation_to_original_evidence.relationship: Implements the DBPF v3 header/index/record identity and QFS extraction behavior used by real packages; the original resource manager itself remains unreplaced.
Reproduces the tested v8 static GMDL prefix and big-endian reference-count quirk; v9 framing and animation semantics remain unsupported.
Extracts positions/normals/UVs/indices, computes bounds, and converts to renderer vertices; color mapping is explicitly visualization, not original behavior.
Validates the RW4 envelope, manifest, type table, and section extents; it does not decode the full RenderWare material/animation/skin payload.
Matches the independently authored raster envelope and DXT5 oracle for verified records; unresolved header words and other raster formats remain unknown.
Maps decoded CellSerializer-derived records to named value objects and validates domains/reference resolvability; the original runtime consumption of every field is not all implemented.
Accounts for all bytes and extracts names/vector-like data from the 0x0F43029A records; per-entry field order and placement semantics remain unresolved.

The camera-ray/plane steering portion is supported by decompilation and ABI docs; keyboard thrust, eat, flee, velocities, and radii are contract approximations/inferences rather than traced original values.
Reconstructs named static fields, initialization constants, 4096 pool capacity, free-list behavior, and cell creation size/state writes from SDK/decompilation evidence.
Implements decompilation-derived query/advect/combat tables and predicates as pure reusable functions; current CellSim integration and runtime field semantics remain partial.
Maps the documented cCellModeStrategy vtable lifecycle and cGameModeManager switching into a clean-room interface; the interface is a reusable shell, not a complete original app system.
Reimplements documented input/UI constants and rollover formula, but the live app still owns camera step magnitudes, HUD pixels, and mode integration.
Preserves renderer concepts and maps draw/resource lifecycle to Vulkan; it intentionally replaces D3D9/RenderWare accidents and does not reproduce the original material/shader system.

Matches the committed decompilation-derived reference over 8 cases and 8 fields, but this is explicitly not live-runtime verification; field meanings and plane values remain bounded by the ABI status.
Implements the current 21-tool stdio MCP facade and safety contract; it is infrastructure around original evidence and does not itself model game semantics.
Implements a local read-only query/browser surface; it exposes evidence state and does not assert original behavior.
